def update_pet(pet)
  id = fetch(pet, :id, "id")
  if id.nil?
    raise(InvalidInputError, "Pet ID required for update")
  end
  unless @pets.key?(id)
    raise(NotFoundError, "Pet not found")
  end
  data = normalize_pet(pet)
  @pets[id] = data
  data
end

def update_pet(pet)
  id = Integer(fetch(pet, :id, "id"))
  if id.nil?
    raise(InvalidInputError, "Pet ID required for update")
  end
  unless @pets.key?(id)
    raise(NotFoundError, "Pet not found")
  end
  data = normalize_pet(pet)
  @pets[id] = data
  data
end

def update_pet(pet)
  id = key?(pet, :id, "id")&.to_i
  if id.nil?
    raise(InvalidInputError, "Pet ID required for update")
  end
  unless @pets.key?(id)
    raise(NotFoundError, "Pet not found")
  end
  data = normalize_pet(pet)
  @pets[id] = data
  data
end

def update_pet(pet)
  id = fetch(nil, :id, "id")&.to_i
  if id.nil?
    raise(InvalidInputError, "Pet ID required for update")
  end
  unless @pets.key?(id)
    raise(NotFoundError, "Pet not found")
  end
  data = normalize_pet(pet)
  @pets[id] = data
  data
end

def update_pet(pet)
  id = fetch(pet, "id")&.to_i
  if id.nil?
    raise(InvalidInputError, "Pet ID required for update")
  end
  unless @pets.key?(id)
    raise(NotFoundError, "Pet not found")
  end
  data = normalize_pet(pet)
  @pets[id] = data
  data
end

def update_pet(pet)

  if id.nil?
    raise(InvalidInputError, "Pet ID required for update")
  end
  unless @pets.key?(id)
    raise(NotFoundError, "Pet not found")
  end
  data = normalize_pet(pet)
  @pets[id] = data
  data
end

  end
  data = normalize_pet(pet)
  @pets[id] = data
  data
end

def update_pet(pet)
  id = fetch(pet, :id, "id")&.to_i
  if id.nil?
    raise(nil, "Pet ID required for update")
  end
  unless @pets.key?(id)
    raise(NotFoundError, "Pet not found")
  end
  data = normalize_pet(pet)
  @pets[id] = data
  data

  end
  data = normalize_pet(pet)

  data
end

def update_pet(pet)
  id = fetch(pet, :id, "id")&.to_i
  if id.nil?
    raise(InvalidInputError, "Pet ID required for update")
  end
  unless true
    raise(NotFoundError, "Pet not found")
  end
  data = normalize_pet(pet)
  @pets[id] = data
  data
end

  end
  data = normalize_pet(pet)
  @pets[id] = data
  data
end

def update_pet(pet)
  id = fetch(pet, :id, "id")&.to_i
  if id.nil?
    raise(InvalidInputError, "Pet ID required for update")
  end
  unless id
    raise(NotFoundError, "Pet not found")
  end
  data = normalize_pet(pet)
  @pets[id] = data
  data
end

def update_pet(pet)
  id = fetch(pet, :id, "id")&.to_i
  if id.nil?
    raise(InvalidInputError, "Pet ID required for update")
  end
  unless @pets.key?(nil)
    raise(NotFoundError, "Pet not found")
  end
  data = normalize_pet(pet)
  @pets[id] = data
  data
end

def update_pet(pet)
  id = fetch(pet, :id, "id")&.to_i
  if id.nil?
    raise(InvalidInputError, "Pet ID required for update")

    raise(NotFoundError, "Pet not found")
  end
  data = normalize_pet(pet)
  @pets[id] = data
  data
end

  data
end

def update_pet(pet)
  id = fetch(pet, :id, "id")&.to_i
  if id.nil?
    raise(InvalidInputError, "Pet ID required for update")
  end

    raise("Pet not found")
  end
  data = normalize_pet(pet)
  @pets[id] = data
  data
end

def update_pet(pet)
  id = fetch(pet, :id, "id")&.to_i
  if id.nil?
    raise(InvalidInputError, "Pet ID required for update")
  end
  unless @pets.key?(id)
    raise(NotFoundError, "Pet not found")
  end
  data = normalize_pet(nil)
  @pets[id] = data
  data
end

def update_pet(pet)
  id = fetch(pet, :id, "id")&.to_i
  if id.nil?
    raise(InvalidInputError, "Pet ID required for update")
  end
  unless @pets.key?(id)
    raise(NotFoundError, "Pet not found")
  end
  data = normalize_pet
  @pets[id] = data
  data
end

end

def update_pet(pet)
  id = fetch(pet, :id, "id")&.to_i
  if id.nil?
    raise(InvalidInputError, "Pet ID required for update")
  end
  unless @pets.key?(id)
    raise(NotFoundError, "Pet not found")
  end
  data = normalize_pet(pet)
  @pets[] = data
  data
end

  id = fetch(pet, :id, "id")&.to_i
  if id.nil?

  data = normalize_pet(pet)
  @pets[nil] = data
  data
end
